messages:
Maya Torres: quick q — our SDKs map 401/403 to the same AuthException today. customers are confused when a 403 (permission) is non-retryable but 401 (expired token) should trigger refresh. can we make the surface clearer?
Samir Patel: yeah noticed that in node + python parity tests. currently both become `AuthError` with message only. we should expose a typed `PermissionDenied` vs `Unauthenticated` or similar.
Joan Chen: strong +1. also we need to standardize an optional `retry_hint` field in error payloads from the API so SDKs can expose a `shouldRetry` boolean/enum without guessing.
Maya Torres: example payload idea? short plz.
Joan Chen: sure — something like:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "permission_denied",
    "code": 403,
    "message": "Project-level role missing: models.generate",
    "retry_hint": "none",
    "request_id": "req_abc123"
  }
}
```
Samir Patel: and for token refresh case:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "unauthenticated",
    "code": 401,
    "message": "Access token expired",
    "retry_hint": "refresh_token",
    "request_id": "req_def456"
  }
}
```
Jordan Lee: love that. SDK mapping proposal: map `unauthenticated` -> UnauthenticatedError (SDK auto-refresh flow triggers if credentials are refreshable), `permission_denied` -> PermissionDeniedError (no retry), `rate_limit`/429 -> RateLimitError (expose `retry_after`), `server_error`/5xx -> TransientServerError (retriable with backoff).
Maya Torres: should we include both `type` and `code` in SDK checks? some customers proxy/nginx may rewrite codes.
Joan Chen: yes, prefer to check `type` first (stable string) then fallback to numeric code. update docs that `type` is canonical.
Samir Patel: for SDK ergonomics: recommend exposing both typed exceptions and a small helper `isRetryable(err)` that uses `retry_hint`/status to decide. sample pseudocode:
```js
function isRetryable(err) {
  if (err.retry_hint === 'refresh_token') return true;
  if (err.retry_hint === 'none') return false;
  if (err.retry_after) return true; // rate limit
  if (err.code >= 500) return true;
  return false;
}
```
Maya Torres: nice. what about streaming errors? clients get a 200 stream then a final event with an `error` object sometimes. parity across SDKs is messy.
Joan Chen: we should standardize: stream control events must use the same error shape (type/code/message/retry_hint/request_id). SDKs should emit the typed error on the stream end event.
Jordan Lee: also add telemetry: `error.type` + `error.code` + `retry_hint` should be logged as structured fields so customers can filter. mention in migration notes.
DevEx Bot: quick link — created doc stub: https://redwood.internal/devex/errors/typed-exceptions (please add examples & language samples).
Maya Torres: action items: 1) API: add `type` + `retry_hint` fields (Joan), 2) SDKs: add typed exceptions + `isRetryable` helper (Samir + Jordan) 3) Docs: examples & streaming guidance (Maya). can owners ack? :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: ack, will update node + python PRs to map types to typed exceptions and add helper.
Joan Chen: ack — will add the `type` and `retry_hint` fields to the errors API and write server-side tests.
Jordan Lee: ack — will add telemetry schema and patch Go SDK.
Maya Torres: thanks all. will follow up with the doc draft and a short migration guide for customers.
